authoringModel.name: Opus 5.5
authoringModel.role: authored these engineering decisions; independent model review is recorded separately by the parent workflow, not by this file

referenceVariety.description: Descriptive US-English engineering baseline taken from the dictionary pronunciations in the pinned pack. It is a convenience reference for engineering, not a prescriptive or correct standard for any speaker.
referenceVariety.note: Any acquired reference recording may carry a different or unknown variety label and must keep that label until the reference register is joined. Reference-asset metadata was not available when these decisions were written.

variantPolicy.meaning: Every dictionary variant in the pinned pack is accepted for engineering exercise. Accepted variants describe intended targets, not the phones a speaker actually produced.
variantPolicy.preferredVariant: variant-1 for every prompt (first listed dictionary form)

occurrencePolicy.rule: Choose the exact source index when one selected-position index exists; choose the first selected-position index when several exist. Every other target occurrence is retained as context.
occurrencePolicy.bananaRule: Choose index 2 (first middle N); retain index 4 as context; this rule requires future clinical review.

instructionPolicy.instruction: Neutral say-the-word, record and replay wording only.
instructionPolicy.adultSupport: A caregiver may read aloud and operate controls.
excluded: mouth, tongue or lip placement advice

decisions.decisionRationale: Both dictionary variants are accepted; they differ only in the unstressed second-syllable vowel (AH or IH). variant-1 is preferred as the first listed form. R occurs once in each variant, at source index 0, which is also the only selected-position index, so it is chosen exactly in both.
decisions.instruction: Look at the picture and say the word "rabbit". Tap record, say the word, then tap replay to listen.
decisions.adultSupport: A caregiver may read the word and these instructions aloud and may operate the record and replay controls. The prompt gives no sound-specific coaching, feedback or diagnosis.
